base_config.description:
Base configuration name, e.g. nam3, based on which this configuration is created.
Only set for user managed configurations.
baseConfig must refer to a configuration of type GOOGLE_MANAGED in the same project as this configuration.
base_config.rationale: The base configuration determines the foundation for the custom instance configuration. It does not directly introduce a security risk but should reference a trusted Google-managed configuration.

deletion_policy.description:
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the instance,
the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.

display_name.description: The name of this instance configuration as it appears in UIs.
display_name.rationale: The display name is a required identifier for the instance configuration. It does not directly introduce a security risk but should follow naming conventions for clarity.

labels.description:
An object containing a list of "key": value pairs.
Example: { "name": "wrench", "mass": "1.3kg", "count": "3" }.


**Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the labels present in your configuration.
Please refer to the field 'effective_labels' for all of the labels present on the resource.
labels.rationale: Labels are used for organisation and cost allocation. They do not directly introduce a security risk but can be used to enforce governance policies.

name.description:
A unique identifier for the instance configuration. Values are of the
form projects/<project>/instanceConfigs/[a-z][-a-z0-9]*
name.rationale: The instance configuration name is an optional identifier. It does not directly introduce a security risk but should follow naming conventions to avoid confusion.

project.description: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: The project field is optional and defaults to the provider project. It does not directly introduce a security risk but should be explicitly set to avoid deploying resources to unintended projects.

replicas.description: The geographic placement of nodes in this instance configuration and their replication properties.

replicas.default_leader_location.description:
If true, this location is designated as the default leader location where
leader replicas are placed.
replicas.default_leader_location.rationale: The default leader location affects performance and latency but does not directly introduce a security risk.

replicas.location.description: The location of the serving resources, e.g. "us-central1".
replicas.location.rationale: The replica location determines the physical region where data is stored. Data residency is enforced at the instance level via the data_residency policy.

replicas.type.description:
Indicates the type of replica.  See the [replica types
documentation](https://cloud.google.com/spanner/docs/replication#replica_types)
for more details. Possible values: ["READ_WRITE", "READ_ONLY", "WITNESS"]
replicas.type.rationale: The replica type affects availability and performance but does not directly introduce a security risk.
